description: Marijampolės savivaldybės Techninių eismo reguliavimo priemonių ir susisiekimo infrastruktūros geografinės informacinės sistemos duomenys is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Marijampolės savivaldybės administracija. Data of the geographical information system of technical traffic regulation measures and transport infrastructure of Marijampolė municipality. Coverage: Marijampolės savivaldybės administracija. The portal shows the English title as "Data of the geographical information system of technical traffic regulation measures and transport infrastructure of Mar" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Marijampolės savivaldybės administracija. Its keywords include Eismas. The listing shows 2026-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
